knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A client deposit is owed as work, so it is a liability until the job is completed.
GST is kept in its own ledger account, as the ATO expects where GST credits are claimed.
Amounts withheld from staff pay are held in PAYG withholding payable until paid to the ATO.
The Australian terms section says to use your ABN on invoices and in the accounts set-up.

practicalCriteria: Learner's chart covers all six categories, each account has a number and description, and GST, PAYG and super payable accounts are present.
